name: Sovereign-NB
description: Deterministic, sub-microsecond bare-metal neural compute engine in #![no_std] Rust booting directly from UEFI.

paragraphs: Sovereign Neural Box is a nostd bare-metal UEFI inference project. Its x86-64 appliance boots a packed ternary model and serves fixed-size input frames over UART; an AArch64 UEFI target exercises the NEON integer kernel and firmware-preserving boot path. Both model math and the in-browser verifier use exact integer operations.
features: Dual-architecture inference: 64→32→16 ternary MLP and 16-dimensional causal linear attention with a persistent 16×16 recurrent state.

No-heap inference core: src/main.rs is #![nostd]; the core does not enable Rust alloc or use Vec/heap allocation. Model, DMA, frame, and state storage use fixed-size buffers. UEFI file I/O writes directly into the…
UEFI x86-64 target: built for x8664-unknown-uefi with the repository's nightly toolchain.
AArch64 UEFI target: cross-compiles for aarch64-unknown-uefi and includes an exact-parity NEON MLP path.
User-friendly model updates: the GPT appliance image has a FAT32 EFI System Partition and a FAT32 NEURALDATA volume. Replace NEURALDATA:\weights.bin to load a different model at the next boot.
